Wait for your account to be activated After selecting Support plan, the account is usually activated after a few minutes, but the process can take up to 24 hours. You will still be able to log in to your AWS account at this time, the AWS Home page may show a â€œComplete Sign Upâ€ button during this time, even if you have completed all the steps in the registration section. After receiving an email confirming your account has been activated, you can access all AWS services. Important The following AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) actions will reach the end of standard support on July 2023: aws-portal:ModifyAccount and aws-portal:ViewAccount. See the Using fine-grained AWS Billing actions to replace these actions with fine-grained actions so you have access to AWS Billing, AWS Cost Management, and AWS accounts consoles.
If you created your AWS account or AWS Organizations Management account before March 6, 2023, the fine-grained actions will be effective starting July 2023. We recommend you to add the fine-grained actions, but not remove your existing permissions with aws-portal or purchase-orders prefixes.
If you created your AWS account or AWS Organizations Management account on or after March 6, 2023, the fine-grained actions are effective immediately.
AWS assigns the following unique identifiers to each AWS account:
AWS account ID: A 12-digit number, such as 012345678901, that uniquely identifies an AWS account. Many AWS resources include the account ID in their Amazon Resource Names (ARNs). The account ID portion distinguishes resources in one account from the resources in another account. If you’re an AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) user, you can sign in to the AWS Management Console using either the account ID or account alias. While account IDs, like any identifying information, should be used and shared carefully, they are not considered secret, sensitive, or confidential information.
Canonical user ID: An alpha-numeric identifier, such as 79a59df900b949e55d96a1e698fbacedfd6e09d98eacf8f8d5218e7cd47ef2be, that is an obfuscated form of the AWS account ID. You can use this ID to identify an AWS account when granting cross-account access to buckets and objects using Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3). You can retrieve the canonical user ID for your AWS account as either the root user or an IAM user.
You must be authenticated with AWS to view these identifiers.
Warning Do not provide your AWS credentials (including passwords and access keys) to a third party that needs your AWS account identifiers to share AWS resources with you. Doing so would give them the same access to the AWS account that you have.

title: Setting up an AWS account
content:
Creating your first AWS account Overview In this first lab, you will be creating your new AWS account and use Multi-factor Authentication (MFA) to improve your account security. Next, you will create an Administrator Group and Admin User to manage access to resources in your account instead of using the root user. Finally, we will step through account authentication with AWS Support in the event you experience authentication problems.
AWS Account An AWS account is the basic container for all the AWS resources you can create as an AWS customer. By default, each AWS account will have a root user. The root user has full access within your AWS account, and root user permissions cannot be limited. When you first create your AWS account, you will be assessing it as the root user.
As a best practice, do not use the AWS account root user for any task where it’s not required. Instead, create a new IAM user for each person that requires administrator access. Thereafter, the users in the administrators user group should set up the user groups, users, and so on, for the AWS account. All future interaction should be through the AWS account’s users and their own keys instead of the root user. However, to perform some account and service management tasks, you must log in using the root user credentials.
Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) MFA adds extra security because it requires users to provide unique authentication from an AWS supported MFA mechanism in addition to their regular sign-in credentials when they access AWS websites or services.
IAM User Group An IAM user group is a collection of IAM users. User groups let you specify permissions for multiple users, which can make it easier to manage the permissions for those users. Any user in that user group automatically has the permissions that are assigned to the user group.
IAM User An IAM user is an entity that you create in AWS to represent the person or application that uses it to interact with AWS. A user in AWS consists of a name and credentials. Please note that an IAM user with administrator permissions is not the same thing as the AWS account root user.
AWS Support AWS Basic Support offers all AWS customers access to our Resource Center, Service Health Dashboard, Product FAQs, Discussion Forums, and Support for Health Checks â€“ at no additional charge. Customers who desire a deeper level of support can subscribe to AWS Support at the Developer, Business, or Enterprise level.
Customers who choose AWS Support gain one-on-one, fast-response support from AWS engineers. The service helps customers use AWS’s products and features. With pay-by-the-month pricing and unlimited support cases, customers are freed from long-term commitments. Customers with operational issues or technical questions can contact a team of support engineers and receive predictable response times and personalized support.

In this case, look for the entry Account and the account ID number next to it.

Find the canonical user ID for your AWS account You can find the canonical user ID for your AWS account using the AWS Management Console or the AWS CLI. title: Virtual MFA Device
content:
Enabling Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) on AWS Note: Before proceeding, ensure you are logged in to AWS using the root user.
Enable Virtual MFA Device through AWS Management Console To enhance the security of your AWS account, you can set up Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). This adds an extra layer of protection by requiring a second form of verification in addition to your password. Follow these steps to set up and activate a virtual MFA device:
Sign in to the AWS Management Console.
In the upper right corner of the console, you will see your account name. Click on it and select My Security Credentials.
Expand the Multi-factor authentication (MFA) section and select Assign MFA.
In the Select MFA Device interface:
Enter a Device Name. Select MFA Device as the Authenticator App. Select Next. Install a compatible authenticator app on your smartphone. You can find a list of MFA-compatible apps here.
Install the authenticator extension for Google Chrome. Select Add to Chrome.
Use the authenticator app to generate an MFA code and enter it for confirmation.
Perform a QR code scan using the authenticator app.
After scanning the QR code, enter the generated MFA codes into the corresponding fields.
Once the codes are entered, select Add MFA to complete the setup.
Complete the additional MFA setup steps as prompted. By setting up Multi-Factor Authentication, you add an extra layer of security to your AWS account, helping to protect your valuable resources and data.

title: MFA for AWS Accounts
content:
Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) Setup During the authentication process, you will need to utilize three different MFA devices to ensure the security of your account.
Virtual MFA Devices (Smartphone Apps): Install the following apps on your smartphone and set them up for MFA:
Microsoft Authenticator Google Authenticator Okta Verify Hard U2F Security Key: Obtain a hard U2F security key to enhance your account’s security.
Other Hardware MFA Devices (e.g., Gemalto Security Keys): Consider using additional hardware MFA devices for added protection.
Content Content 1. Setup with Virtual MFA Device 2. Setup with U2F Security Key 3. Setup with Other Hardware MFA Device 1. Setup with Virtual MFA Device To set up your virtual MFA device using apps on your smartphone, follow these steps:
Step 1: Install the Microsoft Authenticator, Google Authenticator, and Okta Verify apps on your smartphone. Step 2: Open the app and follow the on-screen instructions to add your account. Step 3: Use the app-generated codes during the MFA authentication process. 2. Setup with U2F Security Key Setting up your U2F security key involves the following steps:
Step 1: Obtain a compatible U2F security key. Step 2: Connect the key to your device’s USB port. Step 3: During authentication, insert the key and follow the prompts to complete the process. 3. Setup with Other Hardware MFA Device Consider using hardware MFA devices like Gemalto security keys for an extra layer of security:
Step 1: Acquire a Gemalto security key or a similar hardware device. Step 2: Connect and set up the device as per the manufacturer’s instructions. Step 3: Integrate the device into your MFA authentication workflow. Remember to keep your MFA devices secure and follow best practices to ensure the safety of your account.

title: U2F Security Key
content:
Content
Enable U2F security key via Console If you do not have a hardware device, you can skip the steps below.
Enable U2F security key via Console U2F Security Key is an open authentication protocol that allows users to access online services with a unique security key without using any software.
Sign in to the AWS Console.
In the upper right corner, you will see your account name, select and select My Security Credentials then expand Multi-factor authentication (MFA).
To manage U2F security keys, you must have permissions from the following set of permissions. in the left sidebar, select Policies then select Create policy, select JSON tab and paste the below:
{ "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [ { "Sid": "AllowManageOwnUserMFA", "Effect": "Allow", "Action": [ "iam:DeactivateMFADevice", "iam:EnableMFADevice", "iam:GetUser", "iam:ListMFADevices", "iam:ResyncMFADevice" ], "Resource": "arn:aws:iam::*:user/${aws:username}" }, { "Sid": "DenyAllExceptListedIfNoMFA", "Effect": "Deny", "NotAction": [ "iam:EnableMFADevice", "iam:GetUser", "iam:ListMFADevices", "iam:ResyncMFADevice" ], "Resource": "arn:aws:iam::*:user/${aws:username}", "Condition": { "BoolIfExists": { "aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent": "false" } } } ] } Select Next: Tags. This is a screen of Tags, a tool used to differentiate AWS resources. Select Next: Review. This is the screen that allows you to review the permission set you are creating. Enter the permission set name (eg MFAHardDevice) and select Create policy. In the left sidebar, select Dashboard and then select Enable MFA. Expand Multi-factor authentication (MFA) then select Active MFA.
In Manage MFA Device, select U2F security key then press Continue.
Plug the U2F security key into the computer’s USB port.
Click the U2F security key, and then select Close when U2F is successfully set up.

title: Update the AWS account
content:
Update the AWS account name, email address, or password for the root user Editing AWS Account Information To make changes to your AWS account’s name, root user’s password, or root user’s email address, follow the steps below. Your email address and password serve as credentials for signing in as the AWS account root user.
Note: Changes made to an AWS account may take up to four hours to propagate across all services.
Editing Account Name, Root User Password, or Email Address Minimum Permissions: To proceed with the following steps, you need to have at least the following IAM permissions:
You must log in as the AWS account root user. No additional IAM permissions are required. These steps cannot be performed by an IAM user or role. Sign in to the AWS Management Console using your AWS account’s email address and password.
In the upper right corner of the console, click on your account name or account number, then select “Account.”
On the Account page, locate “Account settings” and click “Edit.” You will be prompted to re-authenticate for security reasons.
Note: If the “Edit” option is not visible, it indicates that you are not logged in as the root user of your AWS account. Account settings cannot be modified while signed in as an IAM user or role.
On the “Update Account Settings” page, choose “Edit” next to the field you wish to update.
For Name: On the “Update Your Account Name” page, enter the new account name in the “New account name” field, then click “Save changes.”
Note: If you encounter issues modifying the AWS account name, check if there’s a Service Control Policy (SCP) within AWS Organizations that restricts access to “aws-portal” or denies the “iam:UpdateAccountName” action.
For Email: On the “Update Your Email Address” page, provide the required information for “New email address,” “Confirm new email address,” and confirm your current password. Afterward, click “Save changes.” A verification code will be sent to your new email address from “no-reply@verify.signin.aws.” On the “Verify Your New Email Address” page, enter the verification code you received via email, then click “Save changes.”
Note: The verification code may take up to 5 minutes to arrive. If you don’t find the email in your inbox, remember to check your spam and junk folders.
For Password: On the “Update Your Password” page, fill in the fields for “Current password,” “New password,” and “Confirm new password.” Then, click “Save changes.” For additional guidance and best practices regarding root user password management, refer to Change the Password for the AWS Account Root User.
Once you have completed all the desired changes, select “Done.”
That’s it! You’ve successfully updated your AWS account information.

title: Create Admin Group and Admin User
content:
Creating an Admin Group Log in to the Control Panel on the AWS Web Service page.
Click on your account name at the top right corner and select My Security Credentials.
Note: If you don’t see the My Security Credentials menu, you can click on the search icon and type IAM. Then click on the IAM service to access the IAM management interface.
On the left sidebar, choose User Groups, and then select Create Group.
Under the Name the group section, enter the Group name (For example: AdminGroup), and scroll down.
In the Attach permissions policies section, type AdministratorAccess in the search bar and select it. Finally, click on Create Group.
The creation of the admin group is complete.
Create Admin User You can use the AWS Management Console to create IAM users.
Follow the sign-in procedure appropriate to your user type as described in the topic How to sign in to AWS in the AWS Sign-In User Guide.
On the Console Home page, select the IAM service.
In the navigation pane, select Users, and then select Add users.
On the Specify user details page, under User details, enter the new user’s name in the User name field. This will be their sign-in name for AWS.
Note: User names can be up to 64 letters, digits, and certain characters: plus (+), equal (=), comma (,), period (.), at sign (@), underscore (_), and hyphen (-). User names must be unique within an account, and they are case-sensitive when used in policies or ARNs. However, they are case-insensitive during the sign-in process.
Select Provide user access to the AWS Management Console. This generates AWS Management Console sign-in credentials for the new user.
You’ll be asked whether you’re providing console access to a person. It’s recommended to create users in IAM Identity Center rather than IAM. To switch to creating the user in IAM Identity Center, select Specify a user in Identity Center.
If IAM Identity Center is not enabled, this option takes you to the service page in the console to enable it. If IAM Identity Center is enabled, this option takes you to the Specify user details page in IAM Identity Center. If you cannot use IAM Identity Center, select I want to create an IAM user and continue following this procedure.
For Console password, choose one of the following:
Autogenerated password: The user gets a randomly generated password that adheres to the account password policy. You can view or download the password on the Retrieve password page. Custom password: Assign a password that you enter in the box. Optionally, select Users must create a new password at next sign-in (recommended) to ensure the user changes their password the first time they sign in.
Select Next.
On the Set permissions page, choose how to assign permissions for this user:
Add user to group: Assign the user to one or more groups with existing permissions policies. Copy permissions: Copy permissions from an existing user with similar needs. Attach policies directly: Attach AWS managed or custom policies directly to the user. It’s recommended to attach policies to groups whenever possible.
Optionally, set a permissions boundary in the Permissions boundary section. This is an advanced feature that controls maximum permissions.
Select Next.
Optionally, on the Review and create page, under Tags, you can attach metadata to the user using key-value pairs.
Review your choices, and when ready, select Create user.
On the Retrieve password page, get the password assigned to the user:
Select Show next to the password to view it manually.
Select Download .csv to save the user’s sign-in credentials as a .csv file.
Select Email sign-in instructions to customize and send an email to the user. The email includes their user name and a URL to the account sign-in page:
User nameURL: https://AWS-account-ID-or-alias.signin.aws.amazon.com/console Note: The user’s password is not included in the email.
If the user also requires access keys, refer to Managing access keys for IAM users.
Login to AdminUser Return to the IAM service, and select Users in the left sidebar. Click on the name of the IAM User you just selected. In the Summary section, select the Security credentials tab. Look at the line Summary: Console sign-in link and copy the link next to it. This is the link you use to log in to the IAM User. Open an incognito tab of the browser you are using and paste the link into the search bar. Incognito tab login allows you to log in to AWS with an IAM User without having to log out of the root user in the main tab.
Enter the correct IAM User name and password that you entered in the create IAM User section above. Click sign in. Congratulations, you have successfully accessed your account as an IAM User AdminUser. In The next step, we will switch to using IAM Role to improve the security of your account. Creating Access Key for AWS Root User Minimum Required Permissions To perform the following steps, you need at least the following IAM (Identity and Access Management) permissions:
You must log in as the root user of AWS, which does not require any additional IAM permissions. These steps cannot be performed as an IAM user or a role.
Use the email address and password of your AWS account to sign in to the AWS Management Console as the root user.
In the top-right corner of the console, select your account name or number, then choose “Security Credentials”.
Under “Access keys,” select “Create access key.” If this option is unavailable, it means you have the maximum number of access keys. You must delete one of the existing access keys before creating a new one. For more information, see IAM Object Quotas in the IAM User Guide.
On the “Alternatives to root user access keys” page, consider security recommendations. To proceed, check the box and then select “Create access key.”
On the “Retrieve access key” page, your Access Key ID will be displayed.
Under the “Secret access key” section, select “Show,” then copy the Access Key ID and Secret Key from your browser window and paste them into a secure location. Alternatively, you can select “Download .csv file” to download a file named “rootkey.csv” containing the Access Key ID and Secret Key. Keep the file in a secure location.
Select “Done.” When you no longer need the access key, we recommend either deleting it or at least considering disabling it to prevent misuse.
Note: These steps apply only to the root user account on AWS. For IAM users or roles, the process of creating and managing access keys may differ.
Revoking Access Key for Root User on AWS Minimum Permissions To perform the following steps, you must have at least the following IAM (Identity and Access Management) permissions:
You must be logged in as the root user of your AWS account, this does not require any additional AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) permissions. You cannot perform these steps as an IAM user or a role. Use the email address and password of your AWS account to sign in to the AWS Management Console as the root user. In the top-right corner of the console, select your account name or number, then choose Security Credentials. Under Access keys, select the access key you wish to delete, then in the Actions section, choose Delete. Note Alternatively, you can choose to Deactivate an access key instead of permanently deleting it. This allows you to continue using it in the future without changing both the key ID and secret key. While the key is deactivated, any requests using it in AWS API requests will fail with an “access denied” error.
In the Delete dialog, select Deactivate, enter the access key ID to confirm your intention to delete it, then choose Delete.

title: Create or update your AWS account alias
content:
Managing AWS Account Aliases for IAM User Sign-In The AWS account root user and AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) users in the account sign in using a web URL.
If you want the URL for your IAM users to contain your company name (or another easy-to-remember identifier) instead of the AWS account ID, you can create an account alias. This section provides information about AWS account aliases and lists the API operations that you can use to create an alias.
The sign-in page URL for your account’s IAM users has the following format, by default:
https://Your_Account_ID.signin.aws.amazon.com/console/ If you create an AWS account alias for your AWS account ID, the IAM user sign-in page URL looks like the following example:
https://Your_Account_Alias.signin.aws.amazon.com/console/ The original URL containing your AWS account ID remains active and can still be used after you create your AWS account alias.
Tip To create a bookmark for your account sign-in page in your web browser, we recommend that you manually type the sign-in URL in the bookmark entry. Don’t use your web browser’s “bookmark this page” feature, as it can capture session-specific information that might interfere with future visits to the page.
Considerations Your AWS account can have only one alias. Creating a new alias will overwrite the previous one, and the URL containing the previous alias will stop working. The account alias must be unique across all Amazon Web Services products. The alias can only contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. Create or Edit an Account Alias Minimum Permissions To perform the following steps, you must have at least the following IAM permissions:
iam:ListAccountAliases iam:CreateAccountAlias Sign in to the AWS Management Console as either the AWS account root user or as an IAM user or role that has the minimum permissions.
Open the IAM console at https://console.aws.amazon.com/iam/.
In the navigation pane, choose Dashboard.
In the right-hand pane under AWS account, next to Account Alias, choose Create. If an alias already exists, then choose Edit.
In the dialog box, enter the new or updated name you want to use for your alias, then choose Save changes.
Note: You can have only one alias associated with your AWS account at a time. If you create a new alias, the previous alias is removed, and the sign-in URL that was associated with the previous alias stops working.
Delete an Account Alias Minimum Permissions To perform the following steps, you must have at least the following IAM permissions:
iam:ListAccountAliases iam:CreateAccountAlias iam:DeleteAccountAlias Sign in to the AWS Management Console as either the AWS account root user or as an IAM user or role that has the minimum permissions.
Open the IAM console at https://console.aws.amazon.com/iam/.
In the navigation pane, choose Dashboard.
In the right-hand pane under AWS account, next to Account Alias, choose Delete.

title: Hàng đợi và DLQ
content:
Mục tiêu Tạo hàng đợi chính nhận đơn hàng và một hàng đợi lỗi (Dead-Letter Queue, DLQ) để giữ lại các tin nhắn xử lý thất bại, thay vì để chúng bị mất.
Ba khái niệm cần nhớ:
Visibility timeout: thời gian tin nhắn bị ẩn sau khi một consumer nhận nó. Nếu consumer không xóa tin nhắn trong thời gian này, tin nhắn hiện lại để được thử lần nữa. maxReceiveCount: số lần tin nhắn được nhận mà không bị xóa trước khi chuyển sang DLQ. DLQ: hàng đợi chứa các tin nhắn lỗi để kiểm tra và xử lý lại. 1. Tạo file template.yaml Trong thư mục order-system, tạo file template.yaml:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09' Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31 Description: Order workshop - SQS va DLQ Resources: OrdersDLQ: Type: AWS::SQS::Queue Properties: MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600 # giu tin nhan loi 14 ngay OrdersQueue: Type: AWS::SQS::Queue Properties: VisibilityTimeout: 60 RedrivePolicy: deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt OrdersDLQ.Arn maxReceiveCount: 3 Outputs: QueueUrl: Value: !Ref OrdersQueue DlqUrl: Value: !Ref OrdersDLQ 2. Triển khai sam build sam deploy --guided Trả lời các câu hỏi như sau:
Câu hỏi Trả lời Stack Name order-system AWS Region ap-southeast-1 Confirm changes before deploy N Allow SAM CLI IAM role creation Y Disable rollback N Save arguments to samconfig.toml Y Khi hoàn tất, SAM in ra QueueUrl và DlqUrl.
3. Kiểm tra trên Console Vào Amazon SQS → Queues. Bạn thấy hai hàng đợi có tên bắt đầu bằng order-system-. Mở hàng đợi chính → tab Dead-letter queue: hàng đợi lỗi đã được gắn, Maximum receives = 3. 4. Thử để tin nhắn rơi vào DLQ Lấy địa chỉ hai hàng đợi vào biến:
$q = aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name order-system --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='QueueUrl'].OutputValue" --output text $dlq = aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name order-system --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='DlqUrl'].OutputValue" --output text Gửi một tin nhắn thử:
aws sqs send-message --queue-url $q --message-body "test-dlq" Nhận tin nhắn nhiều lần mà không xóa (tham số --visibility-timeout 0 làm tin nhắn hiện lại ngay):
1..4 | ForEach-Object { aws sqs receive-message --queue-url $q --visibility-timeout 0 --wait-time-seconds 2 Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 } Ba lần đầu trả về tin nhắn, lần thứ tư không còn gì. Đợi khoảng một phút rồi kiểm tra DLQ:
aws sqs get-queue-attributes --queue-url $dlq --attribute-names ApproximateNumberOfMessages Hoặc vào Console → hàng đợi DLQ → Send and receive messages → Poll for messages.
Các số liệu của SQS là xấp xỉ và có thể trễ vài chục giây.
Kiểm tra kết quả Có hai hàng đợi, hàng chính trỏ tới DLQ với maxReceiveCount = 3. Tin nhắn bị nhận quá 3 lần mà không xóa nằm trong DLQ.

title: Close a standalone AWS account
content:
Close a standalone AWS account Considerations before you close your AWS account Before closing your AWS account, consider the following:
Your agreement with AWS Closing your AWS account serves as notice to us that you want to cancel the AWS customer agreement or other agreement with AWS that governs your AWS account, solely with respect to this specific AWS account. If you reopen your AWS account during the post-closure period (within 90 days after you close the account), you agree that the same agreement terms govern your access to and use of the service offerings through your reopened AWS account.
AWS Management Console access Your access to the AWS Management Console for a closed AWS account is restricted. During the post-closure period, you can still sign in to your AWS account to view your past billing information and access AWS Support. You can’t access any other AWS services or start any new AWS services in the closed account.
Find and terminate active resources To prevent unexpected charges, prior to closing your account, we recommended that you first review and terminate all applicable resources currently running in the account.
Log in to the AWS Management Console. On the navigation pane, choose Services. On the Services page, search for Resource Groups. Under Tag Editor, in Regions, select the regions where you have created resources, or choose All regions. In Resource types, select All supported resource types. Choose Search Resources. If search results appear, then there are still active resources on the account. Note: AWS Resource Groups search results don’t show AWS Marketplace subscriptions. To manage subscriptions, see Managing your software.
You should archive your content and delete the resources where appropriate. For additional instructions on how to retrieve your content, see the documentation for that service.
For more information, see How do I check for active resources that I no longer need on my AWS account?
Existing content and services still in use after closing After the post-closure period, AWS automatically deletes any remaining content in your AWS account, and attempts to terminate any AWS services that are still in use. For more information about the post-closure period, see Accessing your AWS account after you close it.
Your payment method We charge you through your designated payment method for any usage fees incurred before you closed your AWS account. We issue you any refunds that might be due through that same payment method. If you have active subscriptions (such as a Reserved Instance that you pay for monthly), even after your account is closed, you might continue to be charged for the subscription through your designated payment method until the subscription expires or is sold according to the terms governing the subscription. These charges and refunds might occur after you close your account.
In addition, if you reopen your account, you might be charged for the cost of running AWS services (that you didn’t stop before closing your account) during the post-closure period. Closing your AWS account doesn’t affect payment methods that you use on Amazon.com or other Amazon websites.
On-Demand charges During the post-closure period, billing for On-Demand charges stops. However, you’re billed for any usage that has accrued up until the time you closed your account. You’ll be charged for that usage at the beginning of the next month. In addition, if you purchased any subscriptions with ongoing payment obligations, you might continue to be charged for them after your account is closed.
Important: You will continue to generate costs if you don’t stop or delete your resources.
Domains registered with Amazon Route 53 Domains that are registered with Route 53 are not deleted automatically. When you close your AWS account, you have three options:
You can disable automatic renewal, and the domains are automatically deleted when the registration period expires. For more information, see Enabling or Disabling Automatic Renewal for a Domain.
You can transfer the domains to another AWS account. For more information, see Transferring a Domain to a Different AWS Account.
You can transfer the domains to another domain registrar. For more information, see Transferring a Domain from Route 53 to Another Registrar.
If you already closed the account, you can open a case with AWS Support to get help with disabling automatic renewal or transferring your domains. For more information, see Contacting AWS Support About Domain Registration Issues. There is no charge to open a case for domain registration issues.
Charges if you reopen your AWS account If you reopen your AWS account during the post-closure period, you might be billed for the cost of any AWS services that aren’t stopped or resources that aren’t deleted before you close your account.
Example: You reopen your AWS account 30 days after closure. Your AWS account had only an active t2.micro Amazon EC2 instance at closure. For this example, imagine that the price for a t2.micro Amazon EC2 instance in your AWS Region is $0.01 per hour. In this case, you might be charged for 30 days x 24 hours x $0.01 per hour = $7.20 for your AWS services.
Cross-account access to the account youâ€™re closing After you close your AWS account, any access requests to your closed account’s AWS services from other AWS accounts fail. This occurs even if you have granted the other accounts permission to access your account’s AWS services. If you reopen your AWS account, other AWS accounts can again access your account’s AWS services and resources if you granted the necessary permissions to the other AWS accounts.
Removing Amazon VPC peering connection AWS doesn’t delete Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (Amazon VPC) peering connections when you close one of the accounts participating in the VPC peering connection. Any traffic destined for the VPC peering connection originating from other active accounts is dropped because AWS terminates instances and deletes any security groups in the closed account. To remove the VPC peering connection, delete it from your account using the Amazon VPC console, AWS Command Line Interface (AWS CLI), or Amazon EC2 API. For more information, see Deleting a VPC Peering Connection.
Troubleshooting errors when closing an AWS account If you receive an error message while trying to close your AWS account, you can contact your account representative or contact AWS Support to open a billing or account support case for assistance. Common reasons why you might not be able to close your AWS account include the following:
Your account is the management account of an organization in AWS Organizations with active member accounts. To close the management account, you must first remove all member accounts from the organization.
You have unpaid invoices for your account.
You are not signed in to the account as the AWS account root user.
You are an active AWS Marketplace seller.
How to Close Your AWS Account Minimum Permissions To perform the following steps, you must have at least the following IAM permissions:
You must sign in as the AWS account root user, which requires no additional IAM permissions. You can’t perform these steps as an IAM user or role. Review Considerations before Closing Your AWS Account Sign in as the root user of the account you want to close, using the email address and password associated with the account. Note that signing in as an AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) user or role will not allow you to close an account.
On the navigation bar in the upper-right corner, select your account name (or alias), and then choose “Account.”
Scroll to the end of the Account page to the “Close Account” section. Make sure you read and understand the text next to the check boxes. Once you close an AWS account, you will no longer have access to AWS services using that account.
Select the check boxes to accept the terms, and then choose “Close Account.”
In the confirmation box, choose “Close Account.”
Accessing Your AWS Account after Closure After closing an AWS account, you will no longer have access to AWS services using that account. However, during the 90-day period following account closure (known as the Post-Closure Period), you can:
View past billing information for your AWS account. Access AWS Support. During the Post-Closure Period, AWS may retain any content you didn’t delete and any active AWS services. To access remaining content or AWS services, you can reopen your account within the Post-Closure Period.

If you choose to reopen your account, you can access retained content and AWS services that were active before account closure. Note that you might incur charges for running these AWS services during the Post-Closure Period. Use the AWS Pricing Calculator to estimate these costs.

title: Chống xử lý trùng
content:
Mục tiêu Hàng đợi SQS đảm bảo giao tin nhắn ít nhất một lần (at-least-once), nghĩa là đôi khi cùng một đơn hàng có thể được giao hai lần. Nếu không xử lý, khách sẽ nhận email trùng. Ta dùng DynamoDB làm “sổ ghi”: mỗi orderId chỉ được xử lý một lần. Kỹ thuật này gọi là idempotency.
1. Cập nhật template.yaml Thêm bảng DynamoDB và hàm Lambda vào template.yaml. Giữ nguyên OrdersDLQ và OrdersQueue, thay phần còn lại như sau:
OrdersTable: Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table Properties: BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST AttributeDefinitions: - AttributeName: orderId AttributeType: S KeySchema: - AttributeName: orderId KeyType: HASH ProcessOrderFn: Type: AWS::Serverless::Function Properties: Handler: index.handler Runtime: nodejs22.x CodeUri: src/ Timeout: 10 Environment: Variables: TABLE_NAME: !Ref OrdersTable Policies: - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: TableName: !Ref OrdersTable Events: FromSqs: Type: SQS Properties: Queue: !GetAtt OrdersQueue.Arn BatchSize: 1 Outputs: QueueUrl: Value: !Ref OrdersQueue DlqUrl: Value: !Ref OrdersDLQ TableName: Value: !Ref OrdersTable VisibilityTimeout của hàng đợi (60 giây) lớn hơn nhiều lần Timeout của Lambda (10 giây). Đây là cấu hình khuyến nghị khi Lambda đọc từ SQS.
2. Viết mã Lambda Tạo file src/index.mjs:
import { DynamoDBClient } from "@aws-sdk/client-dynamodb"; import { DynamoDBDocumentClient, PutCommand } from "@aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb"; const db = DynamoDBDocumentClient.from(new DynamoDBClient({})); export const handler = async (event) => { for (const record of event.Records) { const order = JSON.parse(record.body); // JSON sai se gay loi -> retry -> DLQ try { await db.send(new PutCommand({ TableName: process.env.TABLE_NAME, Item: { orderId: order.orderId, status: "PROCESSING", createdAt: Date.now(), }, // Chi ghi neu orderId chua ton tai ConditionExpression: "attribute_not_exists(orderId)", })); } catch (e) { if (e.name === "ConditionalCheckFailedException") { console.log("Don trung, bo qua:", order.orderId); continue; } throw e; } console.log("Da xu ly:", order.orderId); } }; Điểm mấu chốt là ConditionExpression: DynamoDB chỉ cho ghi nếu orderId chưa tồn tại, nên lần ghi thứ hai sẽ bị từ chối và Lambda bỏ qua đơn đó.
Ở mục 5.5 ta sẽ bổ sung trạng thái đơn (PROCESSING → DONE) để xử lý trường hợp đã ghi sổ nhưng bước gửi email thất bại.
3. Triển khai lại sam build sam deploy 4. Kiểm thử Lấy các biến cần dùng:
$q = aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name order-system --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='QueueUrl'].OutputValue" --output text $dlq = aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name order-system --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='DlqUrl'].OutputValue" --output text $table = aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name order-system --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='TableName'].OutputValue" --output text Tạo file nội dung đơn hàng:
'{"orderId":"A001"}' | Out-File -Encoding ascii msg1.json Trường hợp 1: đơn hợp lệ
aws sqs send-message --queue-url $q --message-body file://msg1.json aws dynamodb scan --table-name $table Bảng DynamoDB có một dòng A001 với status = PROCESSING.
Trường hợp 2: gửi trùng cùng đơn
aws sqs send-message --queue-url $q --message-body file://msg1.json sam logs --stack-name order-system --name ProcessOrderFn --tail Log hiển thị dòng Don trung, bo qua: A001. Nhấn Ctrl+C để thoát chế độ theo dõi log. Bảng DynamoDB vẫn chỉ có một dòng A001.
Trường hợp 3: tin nhắn lỗi đi vào DLQ
aws sqs send-message --queue-url $q --message-body "khong-phai-json" Lambda lỗi ở JSON.parse, SQS thử lại sau mỗi 60 giây. Sau khoảng 3 đến 4 phút, tin nhắn xuất hiện trong DLQ (Console → DLQ → Poll for messages).
Kiểm tra kết quả Trường hợp Kết quả mong đợi Đơn hợp lệ Có một dòng trong DynamoDB Gửi trùng Log báo trùng, không thêm dòng mới Tin nhắn không phải JSON Sau vài lần thử, tin nhắn nằm trong DLQ Xử lý sự cố Lambda không chạy: vào Console → Lambda → hàm ProcessOrderFn → tab Configuration → Triggers, kiểm tra trigger SQS đang ở trạng thái Enabled. Lỗi quyền DynamoDB: xem log, kiểm tra phần Policies trong template đã dùng đúng !Ref OrdersTable. sam logs không hiện gì: chờ vài giây rồi gửi lại tin nhắn, log có độ trễ nhỏ.

title: Điều phối và thông báo
content:
Mục tiêu Thay vì để một hàm Lambda làm hết mọi việc, ta dùng AWS Step Functions để điều phối quy trình xử lý đơn hàng. Mỗi bước có cơ chế thử lại (Retry) và bắt lỗi (Catch) rõ ràng, trạng thái từng đơn được ghi lại, và quản trị viên được báo ngay qua Amazon SNS khi có đơn thất bại.
Quy trình:
Lambda nhận tin nhắn từ SQS, ghi sổ DynamoDB (RECEIVED) và khởi động state machine. State machine gửi email xác nhận cho khách bằng Amazon SES (thử lại tối đa 3 lần). Thành công: cập nhật trạng thái DONE. Thất bại: cập nhật FAILED, gửi cảnh báo qua SNS, kết thúc ở trạng thái lỗi. 1. Thay toàn bộ template.yaml AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09' Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31 Description: Order workshop - xu ly don hang event-driven Parameters: SenderEmail: Type: String Description: Email da xac minh trong SES, dung lam nguoi gui AdminEmail: Type: String Description: Email nhan canh bao khi xu ly don that bai Resources: OrdersDLQ: Type: AWS::SQS::Queue Properties: MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600 OrdersQueue: Type: AWS::SQS::Queue Properties: VisibilityTimeout: 60 RedrivePolicy: deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt OrdersDLQ.Arn maxReceiveCount: 3 OrdersTable: Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table Properties: BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST AttributeDefinitions: - AttributeName: orderId AttributeType: S KeySchema: - AttributeName: orderId KeyType: HASH OrderTopic: Type: AWS::SNS::Topic Properties: Subscription: - Protocol: email Endpoint: !Ref AdminEmail OrderStateMachine: Type: AWS::Serverless::StateMachine Properties: DefinitionSubstitutions: TableName: !Ref OrdersTable TopicArn: !Ref OrderTopic SenderEmail: !Ref SenderEmail Policies: - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: TableName: !Ref OrdersTable - SNSPublishMessagePolicy: TopicName: !GetAtt OrderTopic.TopicName - Statement: - Effect: Allow Action: ses:SendEmail Resource: "*" Definition: StartAt: SendCustomerEmail States: SendCustomerEmail: Type: Task Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:sesv2:sendEmail Parameters: FromEmailAddress: ${SenderEmail} Destination: ToAddresses.$: States.Array($.customerEmail) Content: Simple: Subject: Data.$: "States.Format('Xac nhan don hang {}', $.orderId)" Body: Text: Data.$: "States.Format('Cam on ban. Don hang {} da duoc ghi nhan.', $.orderId)" ResultPath: null Retry: - ErrorEquals: [States.ALL] IntervalSeconds: 2 MaxAttempts: 3 BackoffRate: 2 Catch: - ErrorEquals: [States.ALL] ResultPath: $.error Next: MarkFailed Next: MarkDone MarkDone: Type: Task Resource: arn:aws:states:::dynamodb:updateItem Parameters: TableName: ${TableName} Key: orderId: S.$: $.orderId UpdateExpression: "SET #s = :v" ExpressionAttributeNames: "#s": status ExpressionAttributeValues: ":v": S: DONE End: true MarkFailed: Type: Task Resource: arn:aws:states:::dynamodb:updateItem Parameters: TableName: ${TableName} Key: orderId: S.$: $.orderId UpdateExpression: "SET #s = :v" ExpressionAttributeNames: "#s": status ExpressionAttributeValues: ":v": S: FAILED ResultPath: null Next: NotifyAdminFailure NotifyAdminFailure: Type: Task Resource: arn:aws:states:::sns:publish Parameters: TopicArn: ${TopicArn} Subject: Canh bao - xu ly don hang that bai Message.$: "States.Format('Don hang {} xu ly that bai. Kiem tra execution trong Step Functions.', $.orderId)" ResultPath: null Next: OrderFailed OrderFailed: Type: Fail Error: OrderProcessingFailed Cause: Khong gui duoc email xac nhan ProcessOrderFn: Type: AWS::Serverless::Function Properties: Handler: index.handler Runtime: nodejs22.x CodeUri: src/ Timeout: 10 Environment: Variables: TABLE_NAME: !Ref OrdersTable STATE_MACHINE_ARN: !Ref OrderStateMachine Policies: - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: TableName: !Ref OrdersTable - StepFunctionsExecutionPolicy: StateMachineName: !GetAtt OrderStateMachine.Name Events: FromSqs: Type: SQS Properties: Queue: !GetAtt OrdersQueue.Arn BatchSize: 1 Outputs: QueueUrl: Value: !Ref OrdersQueue DlqUrl: Value: !Ref OrdersDLQ TableName: Value: !Ref OrdersTable StateMachineArn: Value: !Ref OrderStateMachine Quyền ses:SendEmail để Resource: "*" cho đơn giản trong môi trường thử nghiệm. Với môi trường thật, hãy giới hạn theo identity của người gửi.
2. Thay toàn bộ src/index.mjs import { DynamoDBClient } from "@aws-sdk/client-dynamodb"; import { DynamoDBDocumentClient, PutCommand, GetCommand, } from "@aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb"; import { SFNClient, StartExecutionCommand } from "@aws-sdk/client-sfn"; const db = DynamoDBDocumentClient.from(new DynamoDBClient({})); const sfn = new SFNClient({}); export const handler = async (event) => { for (const record of event.Records) { const order = JSON.parse(record.body); // JSON sai -> loi -> retry -> DLQ // Buoc 1: ghi so, moi orderId chi duoc ghi mot lan try { await db.send(new PutCommand({ TableName: process.env.TABLE_NAME, Item: { orderId: order.orderId, status: "RECEIVED", createdAt: Date.now() }, ConditionExpression: "attribute_not_exists(orderId)", })); } catch (e) { if (e.name !== "ConditionalCheckFailedException") throw e; const { Item } = await db.send(new GetCommand({ TableName: process.env.TABLE_NAME, Key: { orderId: order.orderId }, })); if (Item?.status !== "RECEIVED") { console.log("Don trung, bo qua:", order.orderId); continue; } // Con o trang thai RECEIVED: lan truoc chua khoi dong duoc quy trinh -> thu lai } // Buoc 2: khoi dong quy trinh. Ten execution = orderId nen khong the chay trung. try { await sfn.send(new StartExecutionCommand({ stateMachineArn: process.env.STATE_MACHINE_ARN, name: order.orderId, input: JSON.stringify(order), })); console.log("Da khoi dong quy trinh:", order.orderId); } catch (e) { if (e.name === "ExecutionAlreadyExists") { console.log("Quy trinh da ton tai, bo qua:", order.orderId); continue; } throw e; } } }; orderId dùng làm tên execution nên chỉ nên gồm chữ, số, dấu - và _ (tối đa 80 ký tự).
3. Triển khai sam build sam deploy --guided Giữ các câu trả lời như lần trước. Khi được hỏi hai tham số, nhập:
Tham số Giá trị SenderEmail Email đã xác minh ở mục 5.2 AdminEmail Email nhận cảnh báo (có thể là cùng email trên) Xác nhận đăng ký SNS: AWS gửi một email tiêu đề AWS Notification - Subscription Confirmation đến AdminEmail. Mở email và bấm Confirm subscription, nếu không bạn sẽ không nhận được cảnh báo.
4. Kiểm thử Lấy các biến cần dùng:
$q = aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name order-system --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='QueueUrl'].OutputValue" --output text $table = aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name order-system --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='TableName'].OutputValue" --output text $email = "email-da-xac-minh-cua-ban@example.com" Trường hợp 1: đơn thành công
@{ orderId = "B001"; customerEmail = $email } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress | Out-File -Encoding ascii msg-b001.json aws sqs send-message --queue-url $q --message-body file://msg-b001.json Kiểm tra:
Hộp thư nhận được email Xac nhan don hang B001. Vào Step Functions → State machines → chọn state machine → execution tên B001 → trạng thái Succeeded, mở Graph view để thấy các bước màu xanh. aws dynamodb scan --table-name $table cho thấy B001 có status = DONE. Trường hợp 2: gửi trùng đơn
aws sqs send-message --queue-url $q --message-body file://msg-b001.json sam logs --stack-name order-system --name ProcessOrderFn --tail Log hiển thị Don trung, bo qua: B001, không có email thứ hai. Nhấn Ctrl+C để thoát.
Trường hợp 3: lỗi gửi email
Dùng một địa chỉ chưa xác minh trong SES. Vì tài khoản đang ở chế độ sandbox, SES sẽ từ chối:
@{ orderId = "B002"; customerEmail = "chua-xac-minh@example.com" } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress | Out-File -Encoding ascii msg-b002.json aws sqs send-message --queue-url $q --message-body file://msg-b002.json Đợi khoảng 20 đến 30 giây (3 lần thử lại cách nhau 2, 4, 8 giây), rồi kiểm tra:
Execution B002 ở trạng thái Failed. Trong Graph view, bước SendCustomerEmail báo lỗi, luồng đi qua MarkFailed và NotifyAdminFailure. Email cảnh báo Canh bao - xu ly don hang that bai đến AdminEmail. DynamoDB: B002 có status = FAILED. Kiểm tra kết quả Trường hợp Kết quả mong đợi Đơn hợp lệ Email đến khách, execution Succeeded, trạng thái DONE Gửi trùng Không có email thứ hai, log báo trùng Email không gửi được Thử lại 3 lần, execution Failed, trạng thái FAILED, admin nhận cảnh báo Xử lý sự cố Không nhận được email xác nhận đơn: kiểm tra SenderEmail và email khách đều ở trạng thái Verified trong SES, và xem thư mục spam. Không nhận được cảnh báo: kiểm tra đã bấm Confirm subscription ở SNS chưa (Console → SNS → Subscriptions, trạng thái phải là Confirmed). Không có execution nào: xem log của ProcessOrderFn; nếu có lỗi quyền, kiểm tra phần Policies trong template. Execution báo lỗi AccessDenied ở SES: kiểm tra role của state machine có ses:SendEmail.

title: Thực nghiệm lỗi và tải
content:
Mục tiêu So sánh hai cách xử lý đơn hàng trong cùng điều kiện:
Đồng bộ (đối chứng) Bất đồng bộ (đề xuất) Luồng API ghi DynamoDB rồi gửi SES ngay trong request API chỉ đưa đơn vào SQS; Lambda và Step Functions xử lý sau Chống trùng Không Có (DynamoDB) Thử lại, DLQ, cảnh báo Không Có Chỉ số: phản hồi API (trung bình, p95), đơn hoàn tất, đơn thất bại hoặc mất, thời gian hoàn tất xử lý, số email dư khi gửi trùng, và thời gian có cảnh báo khi lỗi.
Giới hạn của SES sandbox: tối đa 1 email/giây. Email gửi đến success@simulator.amazonses.com (hộp thư giả lập của SES) không tính vào hạn mức 200 email/ngày nhưng vẫn bị giới hạn 1 email/giây. Vì vậy mức tải thử là 20 và 50 đơn. Đây cũng là một kết quả đáng ghi nhận: nút thắt nằm ở dịch vụ gửi email chứ không phải ở kiến trúc.
1. Cập nhật template.yaml a) Thêm tham số vào phần Parameters:
ApiKey: Type: String NoEcho: true MinLength: 16 Description: Khoa bi mat cho header x-api-key b) Sửa state machine. Trong SendCustomerEmail, thay khối Retry để chịu được việc SES giới hạn tốc độ:
Retry: - ErrorEquals: [States.ALL] IntervalSeconds: 2 MaxAttempts: 6 BackoffRate: 2 JitterStrategy: FULL Thay toàn bộ trạng thái MarkDone để ghi thêm thời điểm hoàn tất và đếm số email đã gửi:
MarkDone: Type: Task Resource: arn:aws:states:::dynamodb:updateItem Parameters: TableName: ${TableName} Key: orderId: S.$: $.orderId UpdateExpression: "SET #s = :v, doneAt = :t ADD emailCount :one" ExpressionAttributeNames: "#s": status ExpressionAttributeValues: ":v": S: DONE ":t": S.$: $$.State.EnteredTime ":one": N: "1" End: true Với MaxAttempts: 6 và hệ số 2, một đơn bị lỗi vĩnh viễn (ví dụ email chưa xác minh) sẽ mất tối đa khoảng 2 phút mới được đánh dấu FAILED, thay vì 20 đến 30 giây như ở mục 5.5.
c) Thêm hai hàm API vào cuối Resources (trước Outputs:):
SyncOrderFn: Type: AWS::Serverless::Function Properties: Handler: sync-order.handler Runtime: nodejs22.x CodeUri: src/ MemorySize: 256 Timeout: 15 Environment: Variables: TABLE_NAME: !Ref OrdersTable SENDER_EMAIL: !Ref SenderEmail API_KEY: !Ref ApiKey Policies: - DynamoDBCrudPolicy: TableName: !Ref OrdersTable - Statement: - Effect: Allow Action: ses:SendEmail Resource: "*" Events: Post: Type: HttpApi Properties: Path: /sync Method: POST AsyncOrderFn: Type: AWS::Serverless::Function Properties: Handler: async-order.handler Runtime: nodejs22.x CodeUri: src/ MemorySize: 256 Timeout: 15 Environment: Variables: QUEUE_URL: !Ref OrdersQueue API_KEY: !Ref ApiKey Policies: - SQSSendMessagePolicy: QueueName: !GetAtt OrdersQueue.QueueName Events: Post: Type: HttpApi Properties: Path: /async Method: POST d) Thêm đầu ra vào phần Outputs:
ApiUrl: Value: !Sub "https://${ServerlessHttpApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com" 2. Viết mã src/sync-order.mjs (phương án đối chứng: không thử lại, không chống trùng):
import { DynamoDBClient } from "@aws-sdk/client-dynamodb"; import { DynamoDBDocumentClient, UpdateCommand } from "@aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb"; import { SESv2Client, SendEmailCommand } from "@aws-sdk/client-sesv2"; const db = DynamoDBDocumentClient.from(new DynamoDBClient({})); const ses = new SESv2Client({}); const ID = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/; export const handler = async (event) => { if (event.headers?.["x-api-key"] !== process.env.API_KEY) return { statusCode: 403, body: "forbidden" }; let order; try { order = JSON.parse(event.body); } catch { return { statusCode: 400, body: "invalid json" }; } if (typeof order?.orderId !== "string" || !ID.test(order.orderId) || !order.customerEmail) return { statusCode: 400, body: "invalid order" }; const key = { orderId: order.orderId }; try { await db.send(new UpdateCommand({ TableName: process.env.TABLE_NAME, Key: key, UpdateExpression: "SET #s = :r, createdAt = if_not_exists(createdAt, :c)", ExpressionAttributeNames: { "#s": "status" }, ExpressionAttributeValues: { ":r": "RECEIVED", ":c": Date.now() }, })); await ses.send(new SendEmailCommand({ FromEmailAddress: process.env.SENDER_EMAIL, Destination: { ToAddresses: [order.customerEmail] }, Content: { Simple: { Subject: { Data: `Xac nhan don hang ${order.orderId}` }, Body: { Text: { Data: `Cam on ban. Don hang ${order.orderId} da duoc ghi nhan.` } }, } }, })); await db.send(new UpdateCommand({ TableName: process.env.TABLE_NAME, Key: key, UpdateExpression: "SET #s = :d, doneAt = :t ADD emailCount :one", ExpressionAttributeNames: { "#s": "status" }, ExpressionAttributeValues: { ":d": "DONE", ":t": new Date().toISOString(), ":one": 1 }, })); return { statusCode: 200, body: JSON.stringify({ orderId: order.orderId, status: "DONE" }) }; } catch (e) { console.error("Loi xu ly don", order.orderId, e.name); return { statusCode: 500, body: "error" }; } }; src/async-order.mjs (phương án đề xuất: nhận đơn rồi trả lời ngay):
import { SQSClient, SendMessageCommand } from "@aws-sdk/client-sqs"; const sqs = new SQSClient({}); const ID = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/; export const handler = async (event) => { if (event.headers?.["x-api-key"] !== process.env.API_KEY) return { statusCode: 403, body: "forbidden" }; let order; try { order = JSON.parse(event.body); } catch { return { statusCode: 400, body: "invalid json" }; } if (typeof order?.orderId !== "string" || !ID.test(order.orderId) || !order.customerEmail) return { statusCode: 400, body: "invalid order" }; await sqs.send(new SendMessageCommand({ QueueUrl: process.env.QUEUE_URL, MessageBody: JSON.stringify({ orderId: order.orderId, customerEmail: order.customerEmail, acceptedAt: Date.now(), }), })); return { statusCode: 202, body: JSON.stringify({ orderId: order.orderId, status: "ACCEPTED" }) }; }; Sửa một dòng trong src/index.mjs để thời gian hoàn tất được tính từ lúc API nhận đơn:
// truoc Item: { orderId: order.orderId, status: "RECEIVED", createdAt: Date.now() }, // sau Item: { orderId: order.orderId, status: "RECEIVED", createdAt: order.acceptedAt ?? Date.now() }, 3. Triển khai Tạo một khóa bí mật và triển khai lại (lần này cần --guided vì có tham số mới):
[guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N") # copy chuoi nay lam ApiKey sam validate sam build sam deploy --guided Giữ nguyên các giá trị cũ, nhập ApiKey khi được hỏi. Lấy các biến dùng chung:
$api = aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name order-system --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='ApiUrl'].OutputValue" --output text $table = aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name order-system --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='TableName'].OutputValue" --output text $sm = aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name order-system --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='StateMachineArn'].OutputValue" --output text $env:API_KEY = "<ApiKey-ban-vua-tao>" $env:AWS_REGION = "ap-southeast-1" Không đưa ApiKey và samconfig.toml lên GitHub. Hai đường API này công khai trên Internet (chỉ được bảo vệ bằng khóa), nên sẽ bị xóa ở mục 5.8.
4. Chuẩn bị công cụ đo Trong thư mục order-system:
mkdir tools cd tools npm init -y npm install @aws-sdk/client-dynamodb @aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb tools/loadtest.mjs gửi N đơn với C yêu cầu đồng thời và đo thời gian phản hồi:
// Cach dung: node loadtest.mjs <url> <tien-to> <so-don> <dong-thoi> const [url, prefix, n, c] = process.argv.slice(2); const N = Number(n), C = Number(c); const key = process.env.API_KEY; const email = process.env.CUSTOMER_EMAIL ?? "success@simulator.amazonses.com"; if (!url || !key) { console.error("Thieu url hoac API_KEY"); process.exit(1); } const lat = []; let ok = 0, fail = 0, next = 1; async function worker() { while (true) { const i = next++; if (i > N) return; const body = JSON.stringify({ orderId: `${prefix}-${i}`, customerEmail: email }); const t0 = performance.now(); try { const r = await fetch(url, { method: "POST", headers: { "content-type": "application/json", "x-api-key": key }, body, }); await r.text(); lat.push(performance.now() - t0); r.ok ? ok++ : fail++; } catch { fail++; } } } await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: C }, worker)); lat.sort((a, b) => a - b); const avg = lat.length ? lat.reduce((s, x) => s + x, 0) / lat.length : NaN; const p95 = lat.length ? lat[Math.min(lat.length - 1, Math.ceil(lat.length * 0.95) - 1)] : NaN; console.log(`${url} | gui=${N} dong thoi=${C} | thanh cong=${ok} loi=${fail} | API avg=${avg.toFixed(0)}ms p95=${p95.toFixed(0)}ms`); tools/report.mjs đọc DynamoDB để tổng hợp kết quả xử lý theo tiền tố:
// Cach dung: node report.mjs <ten-bang> <tien-to> <so-don-da-gui> import { DynamoDBClient } from "@aws-sdk/client-dynamodb"; import { DynamoDBDocumentClient, ScanCommand } from "@aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb"; const [table, prefix, n] = process.argv.slice(2); const db = DynamoDBDocumentClient.from(new DynamoDBClient({})); const items = []; let key; do { const r = await db.send(new ScanCommand({ TableName: table, ConsistentRead: true, FilterExpression: "begins_with(orderId, :p)", ExpressionAttributeValues: { ":p": `${prefix}-` }, ExclusiveStartKey: key, })); items.push(...(r.Items ?? [])); key = r.LastEvaluatedKey; } while (key); const status = {}; for (const i of items) status[i.status] = (status[i.status] ?? 0) + 1; const extra = items.reduce((s, i) => s + Math.max(0, (i.emailCount ?? 0) - 1), 0); const d = items.filter(i => i.doneAt && i.createdAt) .map(i => Date.parse(i.doneAt) - i.createdAt).sort((a, b) => a - b); const avg = d.length ? Math.round(d.reduce((s, x) => s + x, 0) / d.length) : null; const p95 = d.length ? d[Math.min(d.length - 1, Math.ceil(d.length * 0.95) - 1)] : null; console.log(`Tien to: ${prefix} | gui: ${n} | tim thay: ${items.length} | mat: ${Number(n) - items.length}`); console.log("Trang thai:", status); console.log("Email du (gui trung):", extra); console.log(`Thoi gian hoan tat (ms): avg=${avg} p95=${p95} (so don: ${d.length})`); if (items.length <= 10) console.table(items.map(i => ({ orderId: i.orderId, status: i.status, emailCount: i.emailCount ?? 0 }))); Thí nghiệm 1: độ trễ và tải Chạy khởi động nóng (tránh tính cả thời gian khởi động lạnh của Lambda), rồi đo 20 đơn. Giữa các lần chạy phải chờ để SES kịp “nguội” (giới hạn 1 email/giây):
$env:CUSTOMER_EMAIL = "success@simulator.amazonses.com" node loadtest.mjs "$api/sync" warm-s 3 1 node loadtest.mjs "$api/async" warm-a 3 1 Start-Sleep -Seconds 60 node loadtest.mjs "$api/sync" s20 20 10 Start-Sleep -Seconds 60 node loadtest.mjs "$api/async" a20 20 10 Start-Sleep -Seconds 120 node report.mjs $table s20 20 node report.mjs $table a20 20 Lặp lại với 50 đơn (s50, a50, chờ khoảng 4 phút trước khi chạy report). Nên chạy mỗi mức tải ít nhất 3 lần và lấy trung bình.
Cần đọc ra:
thanh cong và loi của từng API: đường đồng bộ có bị lỗi khi SES giới hạn tốc độ không? Trang thai trong report: bao nhiêu đơn DONE, FAILED, RECEIVED (bị kẹt), và bao nhiêu đơn mat. API avg/p95 (khách thấy) so với Thoi gian hoan tat (xử lý xong). Thí nghiệm 2: gửi trùng đơn Gửi cùng một orderId 5 lần vào mỗi đường:
$h = @{ "x-api-key" = $env:API_KEY } $body = '{"orderId":"dup-s","customerEmail":"success@simulator.amazonses.com"}' 1..5 | ForEach-Object { Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri "$api/sync" -Headers $h -ContentType "application/json" -Body $body Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 } $body = '{"orderId":"dup-a","customerEmail":"success@simulator.amazonses.com"}' 1..5 | ForEach-Object { Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri "$api/async" -Headers $h -ContentType "application/json" -Body $body Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 } Start-Sleep -Seconds 40 node ..\tools\report.mjs $table dup 2 (Nếu đang ở thư mục tools thì dùng node report.mjs $table dup 2.) Bảng kết quả cho thấy emailCount của từng đơn. Theo thiết kế, đường đồng bộ gửi email mỗi lần nhận yêu cầu, còn đường bất đồng bộ chỉ xử lý đơn đầu tiên.
Thí nghiệm 3: lỗi và cảnh báo Dùng địa chỉ email chưa xác minh để SES từ chối, gửi 5 đơn mỗi đường:
$env:CUSTOMER_EMAIL = "chua-xac-minh@example.com" node loadtest.mjs "$api/sync" f-s 5 1 node loadtest.mjs "$api/async" f-a 5 1 Chờ khoảng 3 phút để các execution thất bại hết các lần thử lại, rồi:
node report.mjs $table f-s 5 node report.mjs $table f-a 5 Quan sát:
Đường đồng bộ: khách nhận lỗi 500 ngay, đơn nằm lại ở RECEIVED, không có cảnh báo nào (đối chứng được cố ý để đơn giản, không có giám sát). Đường bất đồng bộ: API vẫn trả 202, đơn được đánh dấu FAILED, admin nhận email cảnh báo và alarm CloudWatch kích hoạt. Đo thời gian có cảnh báo. Mốc của cảnh báo trực tiếp (SNS) là thời điểm execution kết thúc:
aws stepfunctions list-executions --state-machine-arn $sm --status-filter FAILED --max-results 5 --query "executions[].[name,startDate,stopDate]" --output table Mốc của alarm CloudWatch:
aws cloudwatch describe-alarm-history --alarm-name order-sfn-failed --history-item-type StateUpdate --max-items 5 --query "AlarmHistoryItems[].[Timestamp,HistorySummary]" --output table Lấy hiệu giữa stopDate và Timestamp để biết alarm trễ hơn cảnh báo trực tiếp bao lâu (chú ý hai bảng có thể hiển thị múi giờ khác nhau).
Đo đường DLQ (tin nhắn lỗi định dạng): ghi lại thời điểm gửi rồi so với lịch sử alarm order-dlq-has-messages:
(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("o") aws sqs send-message --queue-url (aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name order-system --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='QueueUrl'].OutputValue" --output text) --message-body "khong-phai-json" aws cloudwatch describe-alarm-history --alarm-name order-dlq-has-messages --history-item-type StateUpdate --max-items 3 --query "AlarmHistoryItems[].[Timestamp,HistorySummary]" --output table Tổng hợp kết quả Điền số đo thật của bạn vào bảng (với mỗi mức tải 20 và 50 đơn):
Chỉ số Đồng bộ Bất đồng bộ Phản hồi API trung bình (ms) Phản hồi API p95 (ms) Yêu cầu bị lỗi tại API Đơn hoàn tất (DONE) Đơn FAILED hoặc kẹt RECEIVED Đơn mất (không có bản ghi) Thời gian hoàn tất trung bình / p95 (ms) Email dư khi gửi trùng 5 lần Lỗi có được cảnh báo không, sau bao lâu Chi phí: sau 1 đến 2 ngày, vào Billing → Cost Explorer lọc theo dịch vụ để ghi nhận chi phí thực tế của toàn bộ thí nghiệm.
Nhận xét và hạn chế Hãy nhận xét theo đúng số liệu bạn đo được, kể cả khi kiến trúc bất đồng bộ không thắng ở mọi chỉ số (ví dụ thời gian hoàn tất thường dài hơn vì xử lý chạy nền). SES sandbox (1 email/giây) là nút thắt chung của cả hai phương án. Để thử tải lớn hơn (100 đến 200 đơn trở lên), cần xin chuyển SES ra khỏi sandbox, hoặc tăng MaxAttempts của bước gửi email. Đơn FAILED hiện chưa có cơ chế tự xử lý lại: do orderId đã được ghi sổ và dùng làm tên execution, gửi lại cùng mã sẽ bị coi là trùng. Đây là hướng cải tiến (thêm quy trình xử lý lại thủ công hoặc dùng mã thử lại riêng). Mỗi mức tải chỉ chạy vài lần, kết quả bị ảnh hưởng bởi thời điểm chạy và khởi động lạnh của Lambda, nên chỉ mang tính tham khảo.

title: Clean up
content:
Mục tiêu Xóa toàn bộ tài nguyên đã tạo để không phát sinh chi phí, đặc biệt là hai API công khai ở mục 5.7.
1. Xóa stack chính sam delete --stack-name order-system --region ap-southeast-1 Trả lời y cho các câu hỏi xác nhận. Lệnh này xóa stack CloudFormation cùng SQS, DLQ, DynamoDB, Lambda, Step Functions, SNS, CloudWatch alarm, dashboard và HTTP API.
Kiểm tra stack đã biến mất:
aws cloudformation list-stacks --stack-status-filter CREATE_COMPLETE UPDATE_COMPLETE DELETE_FAILED --query "StackSummaries[].StackName" --output text 2. Xóa log group của Lambda Log group do Lambda tự tạo nên không bị xóa cùng stack:
$groups = aws logs describe-log-groups --log-group-name-prefix /aws/lambda/order-system --query "logGroups[].logGroupName" --output text $groups -split "\s+" | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { aws logs delete-log-group --log-group-name $_ } 3. Xóa stack quản lý của SAM (tùy chọn) SAM tạo thêm stack aws-sam-cli-managed-default kèm một S3 bucket chứa mã triển khai. Chi phí rất nhỏ nhưng bạn có thể dọn: vào S3, mở bucket có tên bắt đầu bằng aws-sam-cli-managed-default, chọn Empty, sau đó vào CloudFormation xóa stack aws-sam-cli-managed-default.
4. Xóa email đã xác minh trong SES (tùy chọn) Vào Amazon SES → Identities → chọn email → Delete.
5. Thu hồi quyền truy cập Làm bước này sau cùng, vì sau khi xóa khóa thì CLI không dùng được nữa:
Vào IAM → Users → chọn user → Security credentials → Deactivate rồi Delete access key. Gỡ policy OrderWorkshopDeployPolicy khỏi user, rồi xóa policy nếu không dùng nữa. Xóa profile trên máy: mở file %USERPROFILE%\.aws\credentials và config, xóa phần order-workshop. Xóa biến môi trường trong PowerShell: Remove-Item Env:API_KEY, Env:CUSTOMER_EMAIL -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue 6. Kiểm tra lần cuối Vào Console của Lambda, SQS, DynamoDB, Step Functions, API Gateway, CloudWatch (Alarms, Dashboards): không còn tài nguyên order-system nào. Vào Billing and Cost Management → Cost Explorer, kiểm tra lại sau 1 đến 2 ngày để chắc chắn chi phí về 0. Giữ lại ngân sách trong AWS Budgets nếu bạn còn dùng tài khoản này. Checklist dọn dẹp Việc Xong Xóa stack order-system ☐ Xóa log group Lambda ☐ Xóa stack và bucket của SAM (tùy chọn) ☐ Xóa identity SES (tùy chọn) ☐ Xóa access key và policy IAM ☐ Xóa profile và biến môi trường trên máy ☐ Kiểm tra Cost Explorer sau 1 đến 2 ngày ☐
